mapper.select:
select p.PL_Name as plName, c.C_Name as cName,
from SYS_User u left join SYS_PositionLV p on u.PL_ID=p.PL_ID left join SYS_Company c on u.C_ID=c.C_ID
u.U_Id in
#{uId}
mapper.sql: u.U_ID as uId, u.PL_ID as plID, u.C_ID as cID, u.U_Name as uName, u.U_Code as uCode, u.U_MTel as uMtel, u.U_Tel as uTel, u.U_Email as uEmail, u.U_Account as uAccount, u.U_PassWord as uPassword, u.U_Sex as uSex, u.U_Birthday as uBirthday, u.U_State as uState, u.U_MDM_NO as uMdmNo, u.U_CreateTime as uCreatetime, u.U_CreateU_ID as uCreateuID, u.U_CreateU_Name as uCreateuName, u.U_Type as uType, u.U_Office as uOffice, u.U_Cornet as uCornet, u.U_IdCard as uIdcard, u.U_Sort as uSort, u.U_Push_Id as uPushId, u.Open_Id as openId, u.U_Signature as uSignature, u.U_Qualification as uQualification
mapper.select: select mn.Role_Name from SYS_Role mn left join SYS_PositionP_Role ppr on ppr.Role_ID=mn.Role_ID left join SYS_Position_Role pr on pr.Role_ID=mn.Role_ID left join SYS_Position_User_P pup on pup.PP_ID=ppr.PP_ID left join SYS_Position_User pu on pu.P_ID=pr.P_ID where pup.U_ID=#{uId} or pu.U_ID=#{uId}
